Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary from June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (ID, hotel confirmations, flight information)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket (weather can be unpredictable)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (if you prefer your own)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Portable charger for electronics
- Small backpack for day trips
- Flip flops/sandals
- Formal attire (if needed for any special dinners)
